# Plate

> A fitness and nutrition app with AI food scanning, an AI coach, and pantry-to-recipe generation. Built for people who actually move — the gym 3×/week, weekend run, Sunday pickup-sport crowd — not for elite athletes or the wellness-aesthetic market.

Plate is a B2C mobile app available on iOS and Android. Positioning: "MyFitnessPal for people who actually move." Differentiation is three AI features that compound: (1) AI food scan — point the camera at a plate, get calories + macros, (2) Coach Kai — an AI coach that reads your training, meals, and goals to give context-aware advice, (3) pantry → recipe — list what's in your fridge, get a high-protein recipe in seconds.

## Product

- [Landing](https://plate.best/): Product overview, the three AI features, pricing, FAQ.
- [Pricing](https://plate.best/#pricing): Free (with daily AI limits) or Pro at $9.99/month or $69.99/year. 14-day free trial on Pro.

## Quick facts

- **Platforms**: iOS, Android.
- **Pricing**: Free tier with caps (3 scans/day, 1 recipe/day, 10 coach messages/day) and Pro at $9.99/month or $69.99/year for the full limits (30/20/50).
- **AI provider**: Anthropic's Claude (Sonnet for vision and coach calls).
- **Auth**: email + 6-digit OTP via Resend, Apple Sign In, Google Sign In.
- **Data**: never sold. Food photos stored privately, never shared. Full CSV export available. Delete-account is one tap.
- **Built by**: Plate Labs, a small remote team.
- **Contact**: hello@plate.best — a real person reads every message.

## What Plate is not

- Not a medical device. Not a substitute for a doctor or registered dietitian.
- Not for elite endurance athletes (TrainingPeaks fits that).
- Not a social-feed app. No badges, no streaks-as-shame, no celebratory confetti.
